hints.title: Prefix Odd Count
hints.text: The count of odd numbers in range [1, X] is given by (X + 1) // 2.

hints.title: Interval Subtraction
hints.text: The count of odd numbers in [low, high] equals the odd numbers in [1, high] minus the odd numbers in [1, low - 1].

hints.title: Direct Arithmetic
hints.text: Evaluating (high + 1) // 2 - low // 2 gives the exact count in constant time.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Looping from low to high takes O(high - low) time which is unnecessary.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate implements closed-form parity formula directly.
